advisor_identified: Talbot Charles Imlay, historian and faculty member in Université Laval’s Département des sciences historiques since 2000; supervisor of Carl Pépin’s 2008 Laval doctorate.

doctorate.title: How to Win a War?: Strategy, Domestic Politics, and the Political Economy in France and Britain, 1938-40

evidence.says: His 2025 institutional CV identifies Talbot Charles Imlay as a Laval faculty member since 2000 and lists a Yale University PhD in History; it omits the degree year.
Yale’s History Department lists Imlay, Talbot Charles under 1997, with the dissertation title recorded above, matching the linked AHA record.
The bibliography independently cites the matching dissertation by Talbot C. Imlay as a Yale University PhD dissertation dated 1997.
An older institutional CV lists Yale University, PhD History, 1998, creating a one-year discrepancy with Yale’s dissertation list.
Carl Pépin’s author note (p. 7) identifies his 2008 Laval doctorate, Les relations franco-québécoises pendant la Grande Guerre, as supervised by Professor Talbot Charles Imlay.

notes: The full name, Yale History affiliation and dissertation title establish the match. Year recorded as 1997 following Yale’s departmental dissertation list and the independent scholarly citation; an older Laval CV gives 1998, while the current CV gives no year. This date discrepancy does not suggest a namesake.
